proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12559 Śuṣyati explicitly lists Bashkarik šišāl and Chiliss šišēlo dry. These survey śīśāl/śīśelo forms match the cited extended adjectives directly, rather than the separate śuṣka participle. Exact form śīśāl is preserved; possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
